input: Our March invoice shows 42 seats but we only have 35 employees on the plan. Can you correct the charge?
I forgot my password and the reset email never arrives, checked spam too.
The Ledgerquill accounting sync has failed every night this week with a mapping error on the pension account.
The year-end earnings summary CSV is missing the employer contribution column.
Every page in the app returns a 503 for all of our admins right now.
It would be great to have a dark mode for the employee self-service portal.
The card on file expired and I need to update the payment method before the next invoice runs.
My authenticator app was on my old phone and now I cannot get past the two-factor prompt.
Our Clockmarrow timesheet feed stopped importing approved hours since we rotated the API key.
Payslip PDF download produces a zero-byte file for anyone on the hourly template.
Larkspur has been unreachable for our whole team for the last twenty minutes, just a blank page.
Can you add a bulk option to approve all pending expense claims at once?
We were charged twice for the April subscription, two identical debits on the same day.
A new payroll administrator needs an account; please invite them with approver rights.
The webhook for pay-run-completed events fires twice for every run since Tuesday.
Need the general ledger report exported by cost centre rather than by department.
Today's scheduled pay run did not execute and the run status page itself times out.
Please consider supporting fortnightly pay schedules alongside weekly and monthly.
We want to move from the monthly plan to annual billing; what happens to the prorated amount?
Account locked after too many attempts, need it unlocked before the pay run this afternoon.
How do I connect Folkweave so new hires appear in Larkspur automatically?
The custom report scheduled for Monday mornings arrives with last month's date range.
The API is returning 502 to every request from every one of our environments since 09:10.
We would love an option to set a default cost centre per department.
Our accountant can't find the subscription invoice for August in the billing tab; the download works for other months, but the August one was never generated. We need it issued.
Since we switched the company to Kestrelgate SSO, three managers land on a blank screen after the identity provider redirect; everyone else gets in.
Our people can log in, but the nightly Folkweave feed created duplicate employee records for anyone with an apostrophe in their surname.
The pension provider file downloads fine but the contribution column is rounded to whole pounds, and our provider's portal rejects it.
Every admin at our company is getting 'session expired' the moment they sign in, on every browser, and the status banner in the app says degraded.
The CSV export works, but could the report builder let us save a column layout so we don't rebuild it every month?
After adding twelve seasonal workers the plan tier jumped and the charge doubled; the workers are in fine, we just did not expect the price change.
The invoice approver we hired last week says her login says 'no workspace assigned'; her invitation email was accepted.
The journal export to Ledgerquill posts fine, but the pension liability lands in the wrong ledger account; the mapping table in the connector shows the old code.
Employees can log in and see payslips, but the 'download all' zip for the tax year contains only the first three months.
The Ledgerquill sync, the report builder and the pay run page all started erroring at 14:05; nothing works for anyone.
Login works with Kestrelgate SSO; could you add support for enforcing SSO so people can't fall back to passwords?
The Ledgerquill sync is working fine; the problem is that your invoice says 480 and our bank shows a debit of 520 from you.
Payslip downloads fail for one employee with 'not authorised', although her colleagues on the same template can download theirs.
Our bank-file upload to Tessamere Bank is being rejected with 'invalid header record' since your release on Monday; nothing changed on the bank side.
Our subscription invoices download as PDF without trouble, but the payroll cost report we run monthly now exports with the columns in a different order and our macros break.
Payslip downloads return 500 for every employee in every company we manage as a bureau, started ten minutes ago.
Our invoice arrives as one PDF; could it come with an itemised CSV per cost centre as well?
Our finance team got a dunning notice saying the account is past due, but the bank confirms the transfer went out on the 3rd; please match the payment before access is suspended.
The Clockmarrow integration page shows 'you do not have permission to manage connections' for our IT admin even though he set it up originally.
The subscription-charge webhook is sending our finance system amounts in pence while the invoice shows pounds.
The report builder times out when I include the whole company for a twelve-month range; smaller ranges finish, and the rest of the app is fine.
We were mid-way through approving the pay run when the app went down for our whole office; supplier invoices are due to be paid out of this run.
The Folkweave feed runs nightly; is there any plan to make it run hourly or on demand?
The export of our plan invoice shows a 'data processing' line we never signed up for.
Ledgerquill shows our journals posted, but the person who owns the connection gets 'workspace not found' when she signs in, so she can't fix the mapping herself.
The invoice on Ledgerquill's side shows the payroll journal missing for week 31; Larkspur says it was posted, but nothing arrived in the ledger.
The Ledgerquill-format journal we download from the reports page and upload by hand now has the debit and credit columns swapped.
Feature request, I guess: could you make the app load? Every page has shown 'something went wrong' for everyone here since 08:40.
Our invoice download is missing something every finance system wants: a machine-readable e-invoice format alongside the PDF. Would you build that?
The connector page says the Ledgerquill add-on is included in our tier, yet the invoice bills it separately every month.
The payslip export button is greyed out for our new HR assistant, while the same button works for the rest of the team.
Password reset needed on the Folkweave side: our service account's token expired and now new starters stop appearing in Larkspur.
It's an outage as far as our auditors are concerned: every year-end statement they open prints as a blank page, although the rest of the app works normally.
Password reset emails, invitations and every other notification stopped arriving for all users an hour ago, and the queue counter in the admin panel says 'unavailable'.
The Clockmarrow integration is 'broken' for us because it can't import overtime multipliers, which it has never supported; we'd like it to.
The outage last Thursday knocked out our pay run and we still got charged the full month; we want the credit your status page promised.
The whole company is 'down' for me: I can't reach any page after the login redirect, but my colleague sitting next to me is working normally.
Everything is down as far as payroll goes: the Clockmarrow hours never arrived this morning, so we can't run it. The app itself opens fine.
Billing question of sorts: the payroll cost report we send to finance shows employer costs that don't add up to the total row at the bottom.
The Ledgerquill sync alert woke us at 02:00, and on checking, the entire app has been returning gateway errors for every client since then.
Login problem: we want employees to be able to sign in with a passkey instead of a password, which the app doesn't offer.
The advanced reporting feature was switched off in June but it still appears as a line on every invoice since.
Requesting a feature: give our contractor access to the timesheet pages. His account exists but shows only the home tile.
Export to Brindlewick Books is sending payslip totals rounded to the nearest pound, so their side doesn't reconcile.
I'm locked out of the report I need: the pension contributions download says 'file no longer available' an hour after it was generated.
Login is broken for the whole world, not just us: your public status page and the app both time out, and our other office in a different country sees the same.
Export bug: the CSV can't be scheduled to land in our SFTP folder; we currently download it by hand each month and would like that automated.
The Brindlewick Books connector posts the journal an hour late (annoying, not urgent), and we've been billed for the 'bureau' tier since July though we only manage one company.
Our Clockmarrow feed has been importing zero hours since Monday, and on top of that the only admin who can re-authorise it is locked out after an MFA reset.
The monthly cost report CSV has an extra blank column at the end (minor), but the Ledgerquill journal has posted to the wrong period for the last two runs and finance can't close the month.
The scheduled payroll summary arrives every Monday, which is great, but the PDF version has been blank since the 3rd, and could the email also include the CSV?
Two things: our new payroll clerk still can't log in after accepting her invite, and, more urgently, since 10:15 every page for every user shows a gateway error.
Following Tuesday's outage (we read the post-mortem, no action needed) two wishes: a status widget inside the app, and a download of the incident timeline.
The payslip zip export skips leavers, and we'd like a 'leavers only' filter; but first, the pro-rata credit promised when we downgraded in March has never appeared on an invoice.
The cost centre report exports with the wrong date range, and our finance lead can't open the report page at all because her role was downgraded to viewer overnight.
We'd love hourly Folkweave syncs eventually; today's problem is that the nightly sync is creating terminated employees as active.
Two report items: the employee list export drops anyone with a hire date this month, and longer term we'd like a saved-filter option for that export.
The May invoice double-charged us and we want that refunded, but right now nobody at the company can load the app at all: blank screen on every page, every browser.
Our billing dispute from June is settled, thanks. Going forward, could invoices carry our purchase order number, and could the plan page show projected next-month cost?
Since the Clockmarrow release the overtime import maps to the wrong pay code, and our invoice now includes a 'premium support' line we never agreed to.
The invoice for August shows 48 seats instead of 44; also, the four people we removed can still sign in and see payslips.
The Tessamere Bank payment file is being rejected by the bank's connector for a bad checksum since Friday, and while you're there, the same report's download filename still uses our old company name.
Thanks for sorting the login issue last week, closed on our side. Remaining: the pension contributions CSV is missing the employer column again, and could you add a column picker?
The Ledgerquill sync failed overnight, payslip downloads error, and the pay run page won't open; our IT says your API is refusing every connection since 06:00.

The SSO redirect problem is resolved on our side (we had a stale certificate, your team was right). Could the login page show a clearer message when the certificate is expired, and could admins get an alert before expiry?
Could the year-end report include a per-employee pension column? Also our card was charged for 60 seats this month; we have 48 and the seat count page agrees.
It would be handy if invitations could be resent in bulk; more pressing, the twelve invitations we sent yesterday all show 'accepted' but none of the recipients can actually sign in.
Requesting a way to preview the journal before it posts; also, since your Monday release the Brindlewick Books connector posts every journal twice.
The Ledgerquill sync you fixed yesterday is confirmed working, no further action. What's still wrong: the year-end statements download as an empty zip for one of our three companies.
Please add a bulk unlock button; and separately, our whole company is being logged out every thirty seconds, and the status banner says degraded.
The Clockmarrow connector is healthy now that we rotated the key; no fault to report. We'd like the connector page to warn us thirty days before a key expires and to allow two keys during rotation.
